tool.name: Chai-1 API
tool.description: Protein structure prediction via BioLM API (no GPU required)

param.name: api_key
param.label: BioLM API Key
param.help: Get from biolm.ai. Leave empty to use BIOLM_API_KEY env variable.

tool.help:
**Chai-1 Structure Prediction via BioLM API**
Predict protein/DNA/RNA/ligand complex structures without local GPU.
**Input Format (JSON):** ```json [ {"type": "protein", "sequence": "MKFLILLFNILC..."}, {"type": "dna", "sequence": "ATCGATCG"}, {"type": "ligand", "sequence": "CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O"} ] ```
**API Key:** Get your key at https://biolm.ai
**Citation:** Chai Discovery (2024). Chai-1: Decoding molecular interactions.
